activity_additions.name: Prefer / block slot ladder (quest-point scaled)
activity_additions.category: permanent multi-region Slayer task-list capacity residual
requirements: multi-region:slayer-prefer-block-extend point purchases (100 points per Block or Prefer action)
Quest points unlock slot capacity: one block slot and one prefer slot per 50 quest points
Maximum 8 block slots and 8 prefer slots at 400 quest points
Smoking Kills strongly recommended for full point income before mass-blocking
unlocks: Planner-visible capacity residual missing from multi-region:slayer-prefer-block-extend notes (which deferred hardcoding slot counts)
Up to 8 permanent block slots and 8 prefer slots shared across all standard masters
Block: 100 points — skip current task and permanently remove that assignment type until unblocked
Prefer: 100 points — auto-extends current assignment and approximately doubles future chance of that type
Cancelling a preferred task does not refund points; unblock/unprefer is free toggle after the first purchase for Learn-style task adds, but prefer spend is sunk
region_pressure: Slot capacity is quest-point account state (global), not a single-region gate.
Point farm still tracks master regions; blocked-monster relief tracks task geography (combo:slayer-masters-vs-task-regions).
Mandrith (Forinthry) ignores prefer/block lists entirely — residual does not apply to his Wilderness-only assignments.
activity_additions.notes: Does not re-emit Cancel (30) / Extend (30) costs or the base Assignment Rewards row. Jacquelyn point-farm guides often need six early blocks (cave slimes/bugs/cows/frogs/ghosts/birds) which alone want 300 QP for six slots — surface that quest-point pressure is real for ironman block planning.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Global capacity residual. Score QP progress + point-farm masters; treat Mandrith as prefer/block-immune.
